Definition: Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Izrahiah is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 7:3; Nehemiah 12:42. In 1 Chronicles 7:3 we read, "And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Nehemiah 12:42 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Izrahiah is one of the names that makes the Bible feel like a real history to me. A name like this one reminds me that God forgets no one.
